titolo: Google DeepMind previews Genie 4, a real‑time world model with native audio
descr: Genie 4 creates photorealistic, interactive environments with sound and dialogue, now in a research preview for trusted testers.
paragrafi: Google DeepMind unveiled Genie 4, its latest real‑time world model that renders photorealistic scenes and generates ambient audio, music‑like sound, and spoken dialogue.
Users control the simulation with keyboard inputs and plain‑language prompts that can change weather, move the camera, or add objects without restarting the scene.
The system integrates Gemini Omni for visual grounding and Gemini 3.8 Flash as a planner that interprets prompts, breaks goals into steps, verifies progress, and adapts when the world shifts.
Genie 4 runs on Google‑hosted infrastructure and is currently available as a research preview to trusted testers in creative, journalistic, educational, gaming, and engineering fields.
The preview includes safety guardrails, SynthID watermarks on generated media, and acknowledges limitations such as visual drift, short session length, and imperfect object permanence.
perche: Genie 4 offers developers a new way to prototype interactive simulations with built‑in audio, potentially speeding up pre‑visualization and robotics research. However, as a cloud‑only, early‑stage system it does not yet provide a free or locally runnable alternative, keeping the focus on paid Google AI Ultra and early‑access partners.
